title: 2020, Planning Commission Regular Meeting Agenda and Packet

votes.motion: Kory Luker moved to approve the minutes from the February 5, 2020, meeting of the Planning Commission

Debbie Cragun moved to table the matter until the next Planning Commission Meeting, at which time the applicant can hopefully be present. Staff will get more information for the Planning Commission on the existing business pertaining to the questions raised at this meeting. The Planning Commission will reserve the right to re-open the public hearing

Kory Luker moved to forward a positive recommendation to the City Council for the City Engineering Standards and Specifications for the City of Bluffdale, with the addition of the changes suggested to Engineering Staff
